title: Fleet events
description: Lower-priority syslog (severity 4-7) by theme: stability, machine power, changes, hardware, hygiene.

panels.title: Link / routing changes
panels.description: Interface up/down, BGP / PIM / EIGRP neighbour changes (TAG headends left out: UE tunnels coming and going there is normal).

targets.query: severity:>=4 AND (cisco_event:("LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN" OR "LINK-5-UPDOWN" OR "LINK-5-CHANGED" OR "BGP-5-ADJCHANGE" OR "BGP_SESSION-5-ADJCHANGE" OR "PIM-5-NBRCHG" OR "PIM-5-DRCHG" OR "DUAL-5-NBRCHANGE")) AND NOT source:yau-mco-*-tag*

panels.title: UEs with under-voltage
panels.description: UEs reporting ignition / supply under-voltage (machine battery, wiring, cranking).

panels.title: Devices to tidy up
panels.description: Devices logging hygiene events (native VLAN mismatch, leftover Plug-and-Play, ...).

targets.query: cisco_event:("CDP-4-NATIVE_VLAN_MISMATCH" OR PNP-6-* OR DMI-5-SYNC_* OR NDBMAN-5-* OR PKI-6-*)

panels.title: Lower-severity events by theme
panels.description: Severity 4-7 messages per 15 minutes, by theme. 'Other' excludes SSH session chatter unless 'Session chatter' is set to Show.

targets.query: severity:>=4 AND (cisco_event:("LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN" OR "LINK-5-UPDOWN" OR "LINK-5-CHANGED" OR "BGP-5-ADJCHANGE" OR "BGP_SESSION-5-ADJCHANGE" OR "PIM-5-NBRCHG" OR "PIM-5-DRCHG" OR "DUAL-5-NBRCHANGE")) AND NOT source:yau-mco-*-tag*
severity:>=4 AND cisco_event:("SYS-5-CONFIG_I" OR "SYS-5-CONFIG_P" OR "SEC_LOGIN-5-LOGIN_SUCCESS" OR "SEC_LOGIN-4-LOGIN_FAILED" OR "DMI-5-AUTH_PASSED" OR "SYS-6-PRIVCFG_ENCRYPT_SUCCESS")
severity:>=4 AND cisco_event:(SPA_OIR-* OR OIR-* OR IOSXE_OIR-*)
severity:>=4 AND cisco_event:("CDP-4-NATIVE_VLAN_MISMATCH" OR PNP-6-* OR DMI-5-SYNC_* OR NDBMAN-5-* OR PKI-6-*)

severity:>=4 AND NOT (cisco_event:("LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN" OR "LINK-5-UPDOWN" OR "LINK-5-CHANGED" OR "BGP-5-ADJCHANGE" OR "BGP_SESSION-5-ADJCHANGE" OR "PIM-5-NBRCHG" OR "PIM-5-DRCHG" OR "DUAL-5-NBRCHANGE") OR cisco_event:(IGNITION-4-*) OR cisco_event:("SYS-5-CONFIG_I" OR "SYS-5-CONFIG_P" OR "SEC_LOGIN-5-LOGIN_SUCCESS" OR "SEC_LOGIN-4-LOGIN_FAILED" OR "DMI-5-AUTH_PASSED" OR "SYS-6-PRIVCFG_ENCRYPT_SUCCESS") OR cisco_event:(SPA_OIR-* OR OIR-* OR IOSXE_OIR-*) OR cisco_event:("CDP-4-NATIVE_VLAN_MISMATCH" OR PNP-6-* OR DMI-5-SYNC_* OR NDBMAN-5-* OR PKI-6-*)) AND NOT cisco_event:${noise}

panels.title: Flaps by UE (per 15 min)
panels.description: The 30 UEs with the most link / neighbour changes. Darker = more changes in that 15 minutes. A vertical band = many UEs at once (shared cause); a streak = one unstable UE.

targets.query: (cisco_event:("LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN" OR "LINK-5-UPDOWN" OR "LINK-5-CHANGED" OR "BGP-5-ADJCHANGE" OR "BGP_SESSION-5-ADJCHANGE" OR "PIM-5-NBRCHG" OR "PIM-5-DRCHG" OR "DUAL-5-NBRCHANGE")) AND NOT source:yau-mco-*-tag* AND source:yau-mco-flt-ue*

panels.title: Most unstable devices
panels.description: Link / neighbour change counts per device and event, TAG headends left out. Click a device to open it in Graylog.

targets.query: (cisco_event:("LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN" OR "LINK-5-UPDOWN" OR "LINK-5-CHANGED" OR "BGP-5-ADJCHANGE" OR "BGP_SESSION-5-ADJCHANGE" OR "PIM-5-NBRCHG" OR "PIM-5-DRCHG" OR "DUAL-5-NBRCHANGE")) AND NOT source:yau-mco-*-tag*

panels.title: Under-voltage events over time
panels.description: Under-voltage starts per UE per hour (top 15 UEs).

panels.title: Under-voltage by machine
panels.description: Under-voltage starts per UE, with its machine (from the fleet-monitor register via Akvorado). Repeated events on one machine suggest a battery / alternator / wiring issue.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lower(concat('yau-mco-flt-', n)) AS source, anyIf(t, t != '') AS Machine
FROM (SELECT SrcNetName AS n, SrcNetTenant AS t FROM flows
      WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND match(SrcNetName, '^UE[0-9]+$'))
GROUP BY source

panels.title: Changes and logins over time
panels.description: Configuration changes and logins per hour.

panels.title: Change log
panels.description: Latest 300 configuration changes and logins. The message says who and from where (e.g. 'Configured from console by <user> on vty0 (<ip>)').

targets.query: cisco_event:("SYS-5-CONFIG_I" OR "SYS-5-CONFIG_P" OR "SEC_LOGIN-5-LOGIN_SUCCESS" OR "SEC_LOGIN-4-LOGIN_FAILED" OR "DMI-5-AUTH_PASSED" OR "SYS-6-PRIVCFG_ENCRYPT_SUCCESS")

panels.title: Module events by device
panels.description: Module insertion / removal / offline events per device.

panels.title: Latest module events
panels.description: Most recent OIR messages (which module / slot).

panels.title: Top lower-severity events by volume
panels.description: All severity 4-7 events (including session chatter), with device counts. High volume from few devices = a config issue to fix or noise to filter in Graylog.

panels.title: Devices to tidy up
panels.description: Native VLAN mismatches (fix the trunk config), leftover Plug-and-Play / Catalyst Center sync chatter (PnP agent still active after onboarding), certificate messages.

targets.query: cisco_event:("CDP-4-NATIVE_VLAN_MISMATCH" OR PNP-6-* OR DMI-5-SYNC_* OR NDBMAN-5-* OR PKI-6-*)
